claims.statement: The Board approved the capital expenditure plan for the financial year 2026-27.
claims.quote: Approved the Company’s capital expenditure plan for the financial year 2026-27, including the long‑term strategy across its various businesses.

claims.statement: The Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited with the Company.
claims.quote: Approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company.

claims.statement: The Board approved the proposal of divestment of stake held in Akzo Nobel India Limited.
claims.quote: Approval of the proposal of divestment of stake held by the Company in Akzo Nobel India Limited.

facts.statement: Sudhir Sitapati was appointed as an Additional and Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years starting May 29, 2026.
facts.quote: Sudhir Sitapati (DIN: 09197063) was appointed as an Additional and Independent Director of the Company with effect from 29th May 2026 for a term of five consecutive years

facts.statement: The Company maintains a Directors and Officers Liability Insurance policy reviewed annually by the Board.
facts.quote: In accordance with the requirements of Regulation 25(10) of the Listing Regulations, the Company has in place, a Directors and Officers Liability Insurance (“D&O Insurance”) policy.

facts.statement: The Investment Committee comprises two Independent Directors, three Non-Executive Directors, and the Managing Director & CEO.
facts.quote: The Investment Committee (“IC”) comprises of 2 (two) Independent Directors, 3 (three) Non-Executive Directors, and the Managing Director & CEO.
